schema_change.expected_solution: Supabase v0.24.03 ships its auth-schema baseline (auth.users, auth.sessions, RLS policies) in `docker/volumes/db/init/data.sql`. A migration that modifies RLS policies on `auth.users` (e.g., adds a column-referencing policy) and reshapes `auth.sessions` (e.g., new columns or constraints) is the schema-change source. Because Supabase ships PostgreSQL DDL via init scripts and downstream migrations, the change is in this SQL file and any incremental migration directory under `docker/volumes/db/init/`. PostgREST and GoTrue both consume the resulting database schema, but neither sees the migration as a code artifact — they observe it via runtime introspection (`src/PostgREST/SchemaCache.hs`) or by issuing SQL with hardcoded column expectations (`internal/models/user.go`).
evaluation_criteria: Must reference docker/volumes/db/init/data.sql as the Supabase auth-schema source
Must explain that PostgREST observes the schema via runtime introspection rather than code artifacts
Must explain that GoTrue carries hardcoded column expectations in its Go code
Should mention RLS policies on auth.users and the auth.sessions structure as the affected surface

direct_refs.expected_solution: Direct references in PostgREST and GoTrue: (1) `src/PostgREST/SchemaCache.hs` — PostgREST's central schema-cache module that introspects table metadata, enumerates RLS policies, and decides which API endpoints to expose; on schema change it must reload to avoid serving stale policies. (2) `internal/models/user.go` — GoTrue's User struct that mirrors `auth.users` columns; any column rename or removal here causes the Go ORM-level mapping to silently drop fields. (3) `src/PostgREST/ApiRequest.hs` — request-evaluation module that references the schema cache to resolve permissions; if the cache doesn't yet contain the new policy column, requests resolve to 403. (4) `internal/api/token.go` — GoTrue's token-refresh endpoint queries `auth.sessions` directly; any structural change here breaks refresh.
evaluation_criteria: Must cite src/PostgREST/SchemaCache.hs as the PostgREST introspection layer
Must cite internal/models/user.go as the GoTrue auth.users mapping
Must cite src/PostgREST/ApiRequest.hs and internal/api/token.go as the impact-surfacing files
Should explain that PostgREST returns 403 because the cache does not yet reflect the new policy column

indirect_refs.expected_solution: Indirect cross-repo dependencies: (1) the connection lifecycle in PostgREST — when the database emits a `pg_notify` schema change signal, PostgREST should reload its cache; if the listener is not configured, PostgREST keeps serving stale RLS policies that reference deleted/renamed columns and uniformly returns 403; (2) GoTrue's session-management code paths beyond `internal/api/token.go` (token issuance, magic-link, OAuth callbacks) all dereference fields on `internal/models/user.go`'s `User` struct, so any schema drift cascades; (3) the operator-supplied SQL migrations in `docker/volumes/db/init/data.sql` (and successor migrations) are the only place where the three repos visibly meet — neither PostgREST nor GoTrue declares the schema, only consumes it. The impact chain is: SQL migration → stale `src/PostgREST/SchemaCache.hs` → 403 from `src/PostgREST/ApiRequest.hs` → GoTrue token refresh in `internal/api/token.go` fails because session columns no longer match.
evaluation_criteria: Must describe the impact chain from SQL migration → PostgREST schema cache → 403 → GoTrue token refresh failure
Must mention pg_notify / cache-reload as the missing signal that allows the stale state to persist
Must explain that all cross-repo coupling is mediated by the SQL schema (not code-level imports)
Should mention that GoTrue's wider session/token surface (beyond token.go) cascades from internal/models/user.go drift

test_impact.expected_solution: Test coverage required: (1) Supabase-side — SQL fixture tests that exercise migrations under `docker/volumes/db/init/data.sql` (apply baseline, run the new migration, assert tables/columns/policies exist and are well-formed). (2) PostgREST — round-trip tests for `src/PostgREST/SchemaCache.hs` that simulate a schema change and verify the cache reloads correctly; permission-evaluation tests for `src/PostgREST/ApiRequest.hs` covering RLS policies that reference newly added columns. (3) GoTrue — Go unit tests on `internal/models/user.go` for column-mapping completeness and integration tests on `internal/api/token.go` (token refresh path) that exercise the new `auth.sessions` shape. (4) Cross-repo integration test that spins up the Supabase stack with the new migration applied, then runs PostgREST + GoTrue end-to-end and verifies authenticated requests succeed and token refresh works.
evaluation_criteria: Must mention SQL-fixture / migration tests on docker/volumes/db/init/data.sql
Must mention schema-cache reload tests for src/PostgREST/SchemaCache.hs
Must mention Go-side tests for internal/models/user.go and internal/api/token.go
Should describe a cross-repo integration test that runs all three components with the new schema applied
